description: This file defines the EmailService interface for sending emails within the book project, including methods for sending simple messages and templated messages using Thymeleaf.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface defining email sending functionalities, including methods for sending simple messages and templated messages, as well as a default method for extracting username from email.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Method to send a basic email message with specified sender, recipient, and message content.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Method to send an email using a Thymeleaf template, with recipient, subject, and a model for the template, potentially throwing MessagingException.

methods.name: getUsernameFromEmail
methods.description: Default method to extract the username part from an email address.
